title: Cross-vantage transfer of endpoint intrinsic access-barrier persistence and anchor-built intrinsic-denylist validity (same frozen 57-endpoint pool and frozen intrinsic classifier; direct runner egress V1 vs a second independent Tor-exit egress V2)

director_mandate_trace.binding_direction: Vary the SOURCE-VANTAGE factor the accepted S1_STATIONARY packet explicitly fixed and declared a scope boundary (VF5). Do not extend the answered window/timescale ladder at one egress. If a second independent egress cannot be provisioned, record the exact operational blocker; do not substitute a single-vantage run.

three_questions.Q1: At a second independent egress, do the same endpoints retain their intrinsic class (BLOCK_403_CHALLENGE/TRANSPORT_ERROR) with per-class CLASS_PERSISTENCE >= 0.80?
three_questions.Q2: At the second egress, does an anchor-built intrinsic denylist remain valid through delta_ref (FALSE_ACCEPT <= 0.20 and FALSE_REJECT <= 0.20), with the B_EXCHANGE null rejected and a positive endpoint-clustered CI lower bound?
three_questions.Q3: Do per-endpoint intrinsic classes agree across vantages so that ONE shared denylist is licensed rather than a vantage-specific schedule?

parent_handoff_disposition.this_experiment_varies: source vantage (V1 direct runner egress vs V2 second independent egress); protocol, pool, classifier and window ladder are held frozen for comparability.

question: Does the measured endpoint intrinsic access-barrier persistence and anchor-built intrinsic-denylist validity - right-censored at 1800 s on one egress and one session - transfer across independent source vantages, or is S1_STATIONARY an artifact of a single network vantage? Over nominal rungs 0/300/900/1800 s at V2 (second independent egress: distinct public IP/ASN/geography) using the frozen 57-endpoint pool and frozen intrinsic classifier: (Q1) do the same endpoints retain their intrinsic class with per-class CLASS_PERSISTENCE >= 0.80; (Q2) does a V2-anchor-built intrinsic denylist remain valid through delta_ref (FALSE_ACCEPT <= 0.20, FALSE_REJECT <= 0.20, B_EXCHANGE_V2 rejected, positive endpoint-clustered CI lower bound); (Q3) do per-endpoint intrinsic classes agree across V1 and V2 so that ONE shared denylist is licensed rather than a vantage-specific schedule?
hypothesis: H1_VANTAGE_ROBUST: the intrinsic barrier classes BLOCK_403_CHALLENGE and TRANSPORT_ERROR are properties of the endpoint, not of the source vantage. Concretely, at a second independent egress V2 the same endpoints retain their intrinsic class (per-class CLASS_PERSISTENCE >= 0.80), a V2-anchor-built intrinsic denylist stays valid through delta_ref (FALSE_ACCEPT<=0.20, FALSE_REJECT<=0.20), the V2 anchor barrier indicator carries information beyond the exchangeable null (B_EXCHANGE_V2 rejected, positive endpoint-clustered CI), the V1 and V2 anchor classes agree (CV_SKILL significant, positive CI), and the V1-anchor intrinsic denylist transfers to V2 delta_ref (CV FALSE_ACCEPT<=0.20, CV FALSE_REJECT<=0.20). One shared intrinsic denylist is then licensed modulo the frozen pool.
falsifier: The hypothesis is falsified at the frozen thresholds if, with all measurement-validity prerequisites passing, the frozen branch rule selects S0_VANTAGE_SPECIFIC: any of (a) V2_INTRINSIC_PERSISTENT false; (b) V2_DENYLIST_INTRINSIC_VALID false; (c) V2_STAT_SIG false; (d) CV_AGREEMENT_SIG false; (e) CV_DENYLIST_TRANSFER_VALID false (CV FALSE_ACCEPT>0.20 or CV FALSE_REJECT>0.20). Falsification is a scientific result, not a measurement failure; a second egress that cannot be provisioned, pinned or held stable is MEASUREMENT_INVALID, not falsification.

estimators.plugin_mutual_information_binary_nats: I(X;Y) = sum_cells p(x,y) * ln(p(x,y)/(p(x)p(y))) over the 2x2 table of binary barrier indicators, natural log; X=anchor, Y=delta_ref (within-vantage) or Y=V2 anchor (cross-vantage, X=V1 anchor).
estimators.permutation_null: B_EXCHANGE_V2: permute the V2 delta_ref barrier indicator across the 57 endpoints (preserving the marginal) and recompute I(B_V2_T0; B_V2_delta), 10000 permutations, seed 38121193195; p=(1+#{perm>=obs})/(1+10000). B_CROSSVANTAGE: permute the V2 anchor barrier indicator across endpoints and recompute I(B_V1_T0; B_V2_T0), same count/seed. Neither null is a scientific comparator; it is a sampling-exchangeability reference.
estimators.cluster_bootstrap_ci: Nonparametric bootstrap resampling CLUSTERS with replacement, 5000 resamples: primary clusters = endpoint (57), secondary clusters = registrable domain (53, collapsing 7 endpoints on archlinux.org/djangoproject.com/spring.io). CI=[2.5th,97.5th] percentile; a significance clause requires BOTH lower bounds > 0. This only quantifies sampling uncertainty under the frozen pool; it does not license Web-wide generalization.
estimators.class_agreement: CV_INTRINSIC_CLASS_AGREEMENT = fraction of endpoints intrinsic at BOTH anchors with the same intrinsic class. CV_CLASS_AGREEMENT_ANY = fraction with identical class over all 6 classes. CV_MI_CLASS_T0 = plug-in MI over the 6x6 class table at the anchors (secondary).
estimators.denylist_transfer: denylist = the V1-anchor intrinsic endpoint set. CV_DENYLIST_FALSE_ACCEPT = fraction of V1-anchor intrinsic endpoints that are non-intrinsic at V2 delta_ref. CV_DENYLIST_FALSE_REJECT = fraction of V1-anchor non-intrinsic endpoints that are intrinsic at V2 delta_ref. V2_* analog uses the V2-anchor intrinsic set.

baselines.B_EXCHANGE_V2: Permutation/constant reference for within-V2 temporal association (see estimators).
baselines.B_CROSSVANTAGE: Permutation reference for V1-anchor vs V2-anchor class agreement (endpoint relabelling null).
baselines.B_CONSTANT_USABLE: Floor log-loss of predicting the V2 delta_ref barrier indicator from the constant anchor barrier prevalence.
baselines.B_MARGINAL_V2: Log-loss of predicting V2 delta_ref barrier from the V2 anchor marginal only (no endpoint identity).
baselines.B_LASTSWEEP_V2: Class persistence baseline: predict V2 delta_ref class = V2 anchor class.

positive_control.PC_CROSS_SYNTHETIC_STATIONARY: Synthetic world with planted perfect cross-vantage agreement (V2 anchor class = V1 anchor class) and temporal persistence rho=0.98 from the V2 anchor to V2 delta_ref. FROZEN threshold: T1 selection fraction over R=400 synthetic worlds (perms=2000, boot=500, seed 38121193195) must be >= pc_power_min=0.80. DESIGN pre-freeze calibration (R=300, perms=1000, boot=1000): T1 fraction 0.9333 (CV-significant fraction 0.9767); rho=0.92 -> 0.76.
positive_control.PC_SYNTHETIC_STATIONARY: Single-vantage replica control: rho=0.98 internal stationarity; frozen threshold S1 fraction >= 0.80. DESIGN pre-freeze calibration 0.9333.
positive_control.PC_ORACLE_BARRIER: LIVE arena liveness control executed at BOTH vantages at each rung start: httpbin.org/status/429 and httpbingo.org/status/429 -> RATE_LIMIT_429; no-such-host.invalid -> TRANSPORT_ERROR; httpbin.org/status/403 -> UNAVAILABLE_403. Failure -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID. DESIGN pre-freeze probe: 7/7 oracle hosts classified correctly through the V2 tunnel and on V1.

null_control.NC_SYNTHETIC_EXCHANGEABLE: Synthetic world with V1 anchor, V2 anchor and V2 delta_ref i.i.d. from the parent anchor marginal (no endpoint identity, no vantage structure). FROZEN threshold: T1 selection fraction over R=400 worlds (seed 38121193196) must be <= nc_false_positive_max=0.05. DESIGN pre-freeze calibration (R=300): T1=0.0, CV-significant fraction 0.01.
null_control.NC_INDEPENDENT_STATIONARY: Synthetic world where each vantage is internally stationary (rho=0.98) but the two vantages are mutually independent. Isolates the cross-vantage agreement clause: T1 fraction must be <= 0.05. DESIGN pre-freeze calibration (R=300, seed 38121193197): T1=0.0, CV-significant fraction 0.0067.
null_control.NC_CROSS_SUPERSET: Synthetic world where V2 blocks strictly more than V1 (every V1 barrier stays a barrier, plus extra BLOCK_403_CHALLENGE). Must select S0_VANTAGE_SPECIFIC: frozen threshold T1 fraction <= 0.05 (same false-positive budget as the other null controls; an ==0 point requirement would make MV7 fail on sampling noise even when the design is correct). DESIGN pre-freeze calibration (R=300, seed 38121193198): T1=0.0 (CV-significant fraction 0.7933 shows the transfer clause, not the agreement clause, does the work - it is not a vacuous control).
null_control.NC_CLEAN_ORACLE: LIVE arena cleanliness control at BOTH vantages: httpbin.org/status/200, httpbin.org/uuid, example.com -> CLEAN. Failure -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID.

prerequisites.MV1_vantage_distinct: V1 public IP != V2 exit public IP (hard) AND V1 ASN != V2 exit ASN (hard) AND the geo-tuple (country, region, city) is not identical between vantages, i.e. at least one of country/region/city differs (hard); IP/ASN/geo recorded at session start, mid and end. Country-differ is additionally REPORTED as a conservative-reading diagnostic but is not itself a gate, so a non-US-pinned exit is preferred but a same-country exit with distinct ASN/IP/region still satisfies MV1. A same-ASN or same-IP observation at any check -> INVALID.
prerequisites.MV2_vantage_pinned: V2 exit relay pinned (SETCONF ExitNodes=<fingerprint> StrictNodes=1) and identical at session start, mid and end; any rotation -> INVALID.
prerequisites.MV3_anchor_complete: 57/57 endpoints classified at T0 on BOTH vantages; 57/57 at delta_ref on BOTH.
prerequisites.MV3a_pool_exercises: At least one vantage anchor (V1 or V2) has >= 1 intrinsic endpoint AND at least one has >= 1 non-intrinsic endpoint; if the frozen pool yields zero intrinsic endpoints at BOTH anchors the classifier/pool did not exercise and the run is INVALID.
prerequisites.MV5_classifier_replay: Frozen classifier replayed on the parent raw file (research/experiments/EXP-PHYSICS-38074818597/raw/ambient_collection.jsonl, 228 rows) with 0 mismatches AND every live record double-classified from raw fields with 0 mismatches.
prerequisites.MV6_oracles: PC_ORACLE_BARRIER and NC_CLEAN_ORACLE pass at both vantages and every rung.
prerequisites.MV6a_v2_transport_discriminator: A V2 endpoint-level TRANSPORT_ERROR is accepted as an intrinsic class ONLY if the same-rung V2 control-plane fetches succeeded (the HTTPTunnelPort proxy was reachable and the oracle hosts above classified correctly). A proxy-level failure (connection to 127.0.0.1:19051 refused/timed out) is a tunnel failure -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID and must NOT be recorded as an endpoint TRANSPORT_ERROR; an endpoint-specific resolve/timeout failure through a healthy tunnel IS a legitimate intrinsic class.
prerequisites.MV7_controls: ALL declared controls pass their frozen thresholds: PC_CROSS_SYNTHETIC_STATIONARY >= 0.80, PC_SYNTHETIC_STATIONARY >= 0.80, NC_SYNTHETIC_EXCHANGEABLE <= 0.05, NC_INDEPENDENT_STATIONARY <= 0.05, NC_CROSS_SUPERSET <= 0.05.
prerequisites.MV8_v1_egress_stable: V1 ASN constant across all four rungs; a mid-session V1 egress change -> INVALID.
prerequisites.MV9_tunnel_live: Tor bootstrap reached 100% and the HTTPTunnelPort proxy served every V2 GET without tunnel error.
prerequisites.MV10_no_pool_drift: The 57 endpoints are byte-identical (URL strings) to the bound parent spec pool.

validity_notes: V2 is a PUBLIC TOR EXIT. It is a genuinely independent egress (distinct IP/ASN/geo) but carries a Tor-specific reputational blocking policy. Therefore a POSITIVE (T1) result is a CONSERVATIVE robustness result (classes survived a different blocking regime); a NEGATIVE (T0) result bounds the claim to 'V2 differs from V1 under a Tor exit' and cannot by itself separate generic vantage-specificity from Tor-specific blocking. Product adoption would require re-confirming on a non-Tor egress.

LOW-V2-INTRINSIC-CONVENTION: unlike the parent single-vantage packet (which mapped n_t0_intrinsic<3 to MEASUREMENT_INVALID because the floor certified that persistence could be estimated at all), here a validly measured second vantage that exhibits < 3 intrinsic endpoints is SCIENTIFIC EVIDENCE of cross-vantage class disagreement, so it routes to S0_VANTAGE_SPECIFIC with change_class v2_intrinsic_absent_or_insufficient, not to MEASUREMENT_INVALID. Only MV3a (zero intrinsic at BOTH anchors) is an instrument-exercise failure. This deviation from the parent convention is deliberate, justified by the changed research object (vantage, not timescale), and frozen before outcomes.

TREATMENT IDENTITY: the treatment is a SPECIFIC pinned exit relay, not 'Tor in general'. EXECUTE must record the pinned exit-relay fingerprint in result.json/provenance.json; changing the pinned exit mid-session is MV2 INVALID; a post-hoc switch to another exit would be a new treatment instantiation and is not licensed.

TUNNEL-VS-ENDPOINT DISCRIMINATOR: a proxy-level failure is MEASUREMENT_INVALID, not an endpoint intrinsic class (MV6a). Only endpoint-specific failures observed through a healthy, oracle-verified tunnel count as TRANSPORT_ERROR.
Endpoint-clustered bootstrap understates within-registrable-domain correlation for the 3 multi-endpoint domains; the domain-clustered CI is reported and BOTH must be positive.

Same-endpoint V2->V1 fixed request order within each rung can bias rate-sensitive classes; intrinsic classes are order-insensitive by construction and the rate classes are reported as diagnostics only.
delta_ref is right-censored at 1800 s exactly as in the parent; this experiment does not test horizons beyond the ladder.

decision_rule.zero_denominator_convention: For every ratio num/den: if den>0 use num/den; if den==0 the rate is defined as 0.0 AND the companion boolean <NAME>_ESTIMABLE is set false. A clause evaluated with a 0.0-convention rate is satisfied by that 0.0. This is frozen and may not be changed after outcomes are visible.

clauses.V2_INTRINSIC_PERSISTENT: V2_n_t0_intrinsic >= 3 AND for every intrinsic class present at the V2 anchor, V2_CLASS_PERSISTENCE[class] >= 0.80. If V2_n_t0_intrinsic < 3 the clause is false (reason v2_intrinsic_absent_or_insufficient) and routes to S0, NOT to MEASUREMENT_INVALID (see measurement_validity.validity_notes LOW-V2-INTRINSIC-CONVENTION).
clauses.V2_STAT_SIG: V2_STATIONARITY_SKILL_nats >= 0.05 AND V2_STATIONARITY_PERM_P < 0.05 AND V2_STATIONARITY_CI95_ENDPOINT.lower > 0 AND V2_STATIONARITY_CI95_DOMAIN.lower > 0.
clauses.CV_AGREEMENT_SIG: CV_SKILL_nats >= 0.05 AND CV_STATIONARITY_PERM_P < 0.05 AND CV_CI95_ENDPOINT.lower > 0 AND CV_CI95_DOMAIN.lower > 0.
clauses.CV_DENYLIST_TRANSFER_VALID: denominator(V1-anchor intrinsic) >= 1 AND CV_DENYLIST_FALSE_ACCEPT <= 0.20 AND CV_DENYLIST_FALSE_REJECT <= 0.20.

branch_positive.name: S1_CROSS_VANTAGE_ROBUST
branch_positive.condition: MV1..MV10 (incl. MV3a, MV6a) all hold AND V2_INTRINSIC_PERSISTENT AND V2_DENYLIST_INTRINSIC_VALID AND V2_STAT_SIG AND CV_AGREEMENT_SIG AND CV_DENYLIST_TRANSFER_VALID.
branch_positive.reading: One shared intrinsic denylist is licensed modulo the frozen pool and the two tested vantages.

branch_negative.name: S0_VANTAGE_SPECIFIC
branch_negative.condition: MV1..MV10 (incl. MV3a, MV6a) all hold AND NOT S1_CROSS_VANTAGE_ROBUST.

change_classes.v2_intrinsic_absent_or_insufficient: V2_n_t0_intrinsic < 3 (the second egress sees too few intrinsic endpoints; a scientific vantage finding, NOT MEASUREMENT_INVALID since MV3a is separately checked) -> V2_INTRINSIC_PERSISTENT false.
change_classes.v2_intrinsic_break: V2_n_t0_intrinsic >= 3 but some intrinsic class present at the V2 anchor has V2_CLASS_PERSISTENCE < 0.80 -> V2_INTRINSIC_PERSISTENT false.
change_classes.v2_within_vantage_nonstationary: V2_STAT_SIG false at the second egress.

branch_negative.reading: No vantage-blind shared denylist is licensed; the schedule must be per-egress, or (given the Tor confound) the V2 result must be re-tested on a non-Tor egress before attributing the difference to generic vantage.

branch_invalid.name: MEASUREMENT_INVALID
branch_invalid.condition: ANY of MV1..MV10 (incl. MV3a, MV6a) fails OR any live oracle control fails. Branch precedence above all scientific clauses.
branch_invalid.reading: Infrastructure/prerequisite failure; not evidence about H1. Record the exact failing prerequisite and its raw evidence.

V1.provisioning: the GitHub Actions runner's own egress; no proxy.
V1.design_probe: V1 egress is dynamic within a stable ASN: observed 52.157.33.34 AS8075 (Microsoft) US/California on 2026-10-11 and 20.186.238.41 AS8075 (Microsoft) US/Iowa/Des-Moines on 2026-10-12 (check.torproject.org IsTor=false both times). EXECUTE re-records IP/ASN/geo at start/mid/end and requires ASN stability across the session (MV8); IP is expected to vary within AS8075 and is not itself a stability gate.

V2.provisioning: local Tor (apt-get install -y tor; binary /usr/bin/tor) configured with SocksPort 0, HTTPTunnelPort 127.0.0.1:19051, CookieAuthentication 1, MaxCircuitDirtiness 7200, NewCircuitPeriod 7200; pinned to one exit relay fingerprint via ControlPort SETCONF ExitNodes=<fingerprint> StrictNodes=1 (or an equivalent ip-literal pin).
V2.design_probe: PROVISIONABLE at DESIGN (2026-10-11, non-outcome-bearing): tor 0.4.9.11 installed rc=0; bootstrapped 100% in 73 s; unpinned exits rotated (true); ip-literal pin SETCONF -> 250 OK, SIGNAL NEWNYM -> 250 OK, post-NEWNYM exit IP == pinned target; V2 exit observed in NL (192.42.116.14/192.42.116.95), check.torproject.org IsTor=true; distinct from V1 AS8075/US. All 7 oracle hosts classified correctly through the tunnel and on V1. RE-VERIFIED 2026-10-12 (non-outcome-bearing, no frozen endpoint touched): tor binary absent on the fresh runner but apt candidate 0.4.9.11-0ubuntu0.24.04.1 is available (same version as the 10-11 probe), so EXECUTE installs via apt-get; V1 re-observed at 20.186.238.41 AS8075 US (IsTor=false), confirming the stable-ASN/dynamic-IP model. No frozen-pool endpoint was fetched through any tunnel during DESIGN.
V2.construct_validity_caveat: public Tor exit = independent egress but Tor-specific blocking policy; see measurement_validity.validity_notes.

frozen_intrinsic_classifier.source: inherited verbatim from parent spec.frozen_intrinsic_classifier and research/physics/exp_38074818597_lib.py
frozen_intrinsic_classifier.CHALLENGE_RE_LITERAL: (?i)(just a moment|cf-browser-verification|cf[-_]chl[-_]|challenge-platform|cf-challenge|cdn-cgi/challenge|attention required|checking your browser|enable javascript and cookies|verify you are human|please complete the security check|g-recaptcha|hcaptcha|recaptcha|cf-turnstile|<title>\s*just a moment)
frozen_intrinsic_classifier.match_scope: CHALLENGE_RE is applied to the first 262144 bytes of the response body decoded as utf-8 with errors ignored. cf-mitigated is lowercased and compared to the string 'challenge'.

rules.CLEAN: HTTP status in 200..299 (2xx) AND body does not match CHALLENGE_RE.
rules.BLOCK_403_CHALLENGE: HTTP status == 403 AND (lowercase(cf-mitigated) == 'challenge' OR body matches CHALLENGE_RE).
rules.UNAVAILABLE_403: HTTP status == 403 without any challenge marker.
rules.TRANSPORT_ERROR: No HTTP response (DNS failure, connection refused, TLS failure, or timeout).
rules.OTHER_NONBARRIER: Any other HTTP status (404, 500, redirect chains to error) OR a 2xx carrying a challenge marker.

frozen_intrinsic_classifier.reuse_requirement: EXECUTE MUST import the classification function from the BOUND research/physics/exp_38074818597_lib.py (or byte-replicate its constants) and pass MV5 replay (0/228 on the parent raw file). A divergent reimplementation is a measurement-validity failure.

sweep_protocol.session_t0: the instant of the first V2 GET of rung 0
sweep_protocol.per_rung_order: deterministic shuffle seeded by (38121193195 + rung_index) so order is reproducible; record order_pos.
sweep_protocol.per_endpoint_per_rung: one V2 GET (through the Tor HTTPTunnelPort) immediately followed by one V1 GET (direct), same endpoint, then next endpoint.

http.cookies: fresh CookieJar per call; never persisted
http.user_agent: frozen UA string identical to parent

product_consequence_positive: S1_CROSS_VANTAGE_ROBUST licenses a SHARED mechanical intrinsic denylist across the two tested egress vantages modulo the frozen pool: exploration scheduling can carry one class-conditional barrier prior instead of per-egress calibration. C-WEB-DYNAMICS may then be considered for EXPERIMENTAL only via the normal DIRECTOR verdict path; DESIGN claims no promotion.
product_consequence_negative: S0_VANTAGE_SPECIFIC means no vantage-blind shared denylist is licensed: scheduling/barrier policy must be built per egress (or re-tested per egress). This bounds S1_STATIONARY as vantage-conditional and prevents a false-accept-prone shared denylist from shipping. Under the Tor confound, a negative additionally requires a non-Tor egress before attributing the failure to generic vantage-specificity rather than Tor-specific blocking.

estimated_cost.compute: stdlib only; 2 permutation tests x 10000 perms; 4 cluster-bootstrap CIs x 5000 resamples; synthetic PC/NC R=400 each
estimated_cost.wall_clock: ~1800 s ladder + ~75 s Tor bootstrap + overheads; single session
estimated_cost.network: credential-free, unauthenticated GETs; no paid substrate

expected_information_gain: Directly tests the dominant external-validity threat to the program's only accepted Physics positive. A positive turns a single-vantage bounded result into a two-vantage robustness result and licenses a shared denylist; a negative bounds it as vantage-specific and prevents one. Either outcome changes the re-observe scheduling decision; the experiment is orthogonal to the answered timescale axis and reuses the frozen pool/classifier, so it adds no new mechanism to the inventory.
